description:
The Indian Health Service, Navajo Area, Crownpoint Healthcare Facility, located in/at the JCT. of NM State Hwy 371 & Navajo Route 9, Crownpoint, NM 87313 has an upcoming requirement for, six (6) vital signs monitoring systems to replace exiting bedside vital signs monitors currently in use.

The required monitors must be capable of measuring, at a minimum, non-invasive blood pressure (NIBP), pulse rate, oxygen saturation (SpO₂), and temperature, and must be suitable for use in a clinical patient-care environment.

The Government’s current configuration utilizes Welch Allyn Connex® 360 (95MXT-B) Vital Signs Monitors. Vendors may propose Welch Allyn Connex 360 (95MXT-B) or functionally equivalent equipment that meets or exceeds the Government’s clinical, operational, and interoperability requirements.

The requirement also includes six (6) compatible mobile stand mounting, to allow safe transport and point-of-care use within clinical areas.

The North American Industry Classification System or NAICS code is 334510 – Electromedical and Electrotherapeutic Apparatus with a small business size standard of 1,250 employees. 

The Request for Quotations No. 75H71026Q00083 in accordance with 12.201-1 will be issued on or by March 14, 2026.  Evaluation factors may include technical capability to meet the government needs, past performance, and price.  Quotes will be due on or by March 21, 2026.  The acquisition is an Indian Small Business Economic Enterprise (ISBEE) set-aside.

In accordance with 52.204-7 the offeror shall have an active Federal Government contracts registration in the System for Award Management (SAM) when submitting an offer or quotation in response to this solicitation and at the time of award.

For additional information, contact Marshall L. Arviso, Contract Specialist @ marshall.arviso@ihs.gov

THIS IS NOT A SOLICITATION.
